subject.title: Voice transcript recovery turn generates response but delivery-mirror drops Telegram reply

question: Should this stay proof-gated until a live Telegram voice recovery reproduction isolates the failing boundary, or should a maintainer promote a source-level investigation now?
rationale: The report is plausible and high impact, but current evidence does not identify whether the remaining failure is recovery correlation, final delivery accounting, transcript mirroring, or an adjacent fallback branch.

options.title: Keep proof-gated

options.title: Promote investigation
